Drive continuous improvement by maintaining bid libraries, capturing lessons learned, analysing outcomes, and implementing best practices to improve win rates and efficiency. Champion the adoption of AI, automation, and digital tools to enhance proposal development, knowledge management, and bid management processes. Support commercial growth initiatives by contributing to win strategies. A customer-focused mindset with strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex customer requirements into compelling business solutions. Play a strategic role in securing major customer wins and influencing business growth. Be at the forefront of innovation by helping shape the future of bid management through AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives. Benefit from a collaborative and inclusive culture that values knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and professional development.
